love.title: Love messages
love.subtitle: A small hello to {call}
love.intro: When {call} confirms a medicine or answers the morning check-in, you can send a small warm message back on WhatsApp, like "Riya saw that you took your medicine ❤️". It only goes out after {call} has written to us, so it never costs extra.

note.hepb4: IAP: a 4th dose of Hepatitis B is safe and permitted when it is part of a combination vaccine. Ask your doctor whether it applies.
note.rotavirus3: IAP: not needed with the 2-dose rotavirus vaccine RV1 (GSK); other brands have 3 doses. Ask your doctor.
note.influenzaYearly: IAP: after this, the flu vaccine is repeated every year, before the monsoon, till 5 years of age. Ask your doctor.
note.hepa1: IAP: one dose for the live hepatitis A vaccine; the inactivated vaccine needs two doses.
note.hepa2: IAP: only for the inactivated hepatitis A vaccine. Ask your doctor which one was given.
note.hpv2dose: IAP: from 9 to 14 years, two doses 6 months apart, for girls and boys.
note.tdap: IAP: given at 10 years even if Tdap was given earlier as the DTP booster. Ask your doctor.
